caption: The drawing depicts a woman standing inside an ornate, open-fronted booth or structure. The woman has long black hair and is wearing a floor-length red dress with a yellow belt and a large blue shoulder covering that features a yellow teardrop shape on one side. Her left arm is bent upward, holding a small bucket suspended by a string, while her right arm is extended outward. The booth is composed of blue and yellow pillars and is adorned with stylized floral and geometric patterns colored primarily in blue, yellow, red, and gray. The booth's side panels and decorative top feature intricate, symmetrical designs in muted gray, yellow, and red tones, including fan-shaped and feather-like motifs. The background is beige, and no additional objects or figures appear outside the booth. The artist's signature "M. PARISI" is visible in the bottom right corner.
title: Tin Nicho with Santo Nino
